calls.summary:
We need to summarize the sales call transcript in 2-3 sentences focusing on what was discussed (product, features, pain points), key participants and roles, and next steps/action items.

Key participants: Daniel Wathne (GrowthBook account executive? Sales?), Logan Bates (GrowthBook engineer/technical?), Jay Jana (First Table - likely product/tech lead?).

Discussed: GrowthBook's experimentation platform. Jay's company (First Table) already has SDKs implemented. They want to use APIs/CLI for automated experiment creation via AI (Cursor). Pain points: need guardrails/kill switches for safe rollouts, managed data warehouse (they don't have own yet, considering Snowflake later). Key features: MCP server for AI integration, safe rollouts with guardrail metrics, managed warehouse (Clickhouse), ability to analyze metrics retrospectively. Pricing: enterprise tier around $20-30k, need justification for CFO.

Next steps: Daniel will provide order form, comparison of pro vs enterprise for business case, documentation on managed warehouse. Logan will share docs on MCP server and warehouse. Jay will add data lead (Samuel) to Slack. Goal: sign agreement in March.

calls.title: Growthbook <> First Table - Data Warehouse Sync
calls.summary: First Table is focused on developing a unified data strategy to enhance its analytics capabilities and tackle fragmented data issues. Samuel Yap-Choong, who joined as the lead for this initiative, is guiding the team to create a data warehouse as a central pillar for data unification. The plan includes hiring a data engineer, a data scientist, and future graduates to bolster data product insights. Growth Book is being adopted to improve experimentation through a direct connection to the warehouse. The company is also leveraging AWS infrastructure to support scalable data operations. Emphasis is placed on cross-team collaboration to ensure clear roles, effective communication, and rapid iteration in optimizing data usage for decision-making.
calls.keywords: Data Warehouse, GrowthBook, Experimentation Platform, AWS, Data Integration, CRO
